name: Launchpane
tagline: Know what starts on your Mac
taglineAlternates: See and control what starts on your Mac
Launch agents, daemons, and login items in one window
Free, open-source launchd manager for macOS
description: Launchpane shows macOS launch agents, daemons, and login items in one window. Free and MIT-licensed. The signed, Apple-notarized download controls services, reads logs, and edits schedules. Also on the Mac App Store for inspection and plist editing.

gallery.caption: Launch agents, daemons, and login items in one native window.
gallery.alt: Launchpane in dark mode listing four demo launch agents with their source, status, enabled state, PID, last run, and a primary action for each.

gallery.caption: Filter by source: your agents, user agents, system agents, system daemons, or login items.
gallery.alt: The service source menu open, listing All services, My agents, User agents, System agents, System daemons, and Login items with a short description of each.

gallery.caption: Unavailable actions stay visible and say why.
gallery.alt: The actions menu for a running demo agent. Load, Run now, and Enable are dimmed with reasons such as Already loaded; Unload, Restart, Disable, and Reveal in Finder are available.

gallery.caption: Last exit status and standard error for a failing agent.
gallery.alt: Detail panel for a demo sync agent showing last exit 1 and a standard error line saying the destination volume is not mounted.

gallery.caption: Interval or calendar schedules with a preview of the next runs.
gallery.alt: Edit Agent form with a daily calendar schedule and a Next runs preview listing the next three run times.

gallery.caption: The equivalent launchctl commands, ready to copy.
gallery.alt: Commands tab listing launchctl kickstart, bootout, enable, disable, and print commands for a demo agent, each with a copy button.

gallery.caption: On the Mac App Store, or as a signed, Apple-notarized download from GitHub.
gallery.alt: Launchpane icon and name with the tagline Know what starts on your Mac. Below it, Apple's Download on the Mac App Store badge, noted as sandboxed for inspecting and editing plists, and a Download from GitHub Releases button, noted as recommended, Developer ID signed, and Apple notarized. Labels for the MIT license, Apple silicon, Intel, and Universal builds, and no analytics or accounts, then the GitHub address.

credits: Launchpane builds on azu's open-source launchd-ui (https://github.com/azu/launchd-ui).
